author: Claude
headline: Famous companies that are far off their highs now lead the picks: Nvidia, Intel, AMD, Netflix and more
summary: You buy well-known companies when they're down, so the picks now give household names that have dropped a lot an extra boost. Nvidia is 39% below its high with analysts seeing about 104% upside. Intel is 62% below with about 108% upside. AMD is 38% below but still up 90% over a year. Netflix is 46% below with 45% analyst upside, Micron is 52% below, and TSMC, ASML and Dell are all deeply marked down. These are bets rather than sure things: some, like Nvidia and Netflix, are down over the past year, so they can fall further before they recover. US markets are shut today for Thanksgiving, so prices won't move until Friday.
points: Nvidia: 39% off its high, analysts see ~104% upside. A famous company on sale.
Intel: 62% below its high but still up 48% over a year; analysts see ~108% upside.
AMD, Micron and Dell are 38–52% below their highs yet up a lot over the past year.
Netflix: 46% below its high; analysts see ~45% upside, but it's down 44% over a year.
Buy in a few smaller amounts rather than all at once, as dips can keep falling. Not financial advice.
